historical_exposure: All original training images and official test labels were used by the historical notebook. Current locked holdout is excluded from new training and selection; it is not claimed to be historically unseen.

selection.tie_break: higher validation accuracy, then lower validation CE, then earlier declared candidate
selection.non_improvement_policy: Reject KD candidates without at least 0.2 percentage-point validation gain. No extra temperatures, architectures or final-driven retuning.
selection.confirmation_policy: Reuse pilot seed 378 paired runs. Train only the selected fixed KD recipe and matched baseline for seeds 379 and 380. Require mean validation gain >=0.2 percentage points and at least two positive seed pairs. Preserve unsuccessful results.
selection.final_policy: Freeze model and configuration hashes before locked holdout and historically exposed official-test audit. No reselection or new experiments after final metrics are accessed. Deployment seed 378 is declared in advance.
